currency.basis: The /logo/kompanion-logo.svg asset is the live header logo of the operating site observed 2026-10-04, ~2.5 years after the rebrand; current 2025-2026 news/tariff documents on the same domain confirm continued operation under the new identity. The baseline pinwheel is the superseded pre-2024 design.

identity.basis: Fetched asset is served by the bank's own domain as its header logo and depicts the new green leaf/«K» emblem + KOMPANION BANK wordmark; the announcement page attributes the new logo to Банк Компаньон dated 2024-05-09.

assessment.independenceRationale: Primary evidence is the bank's own domain (announcement page and served logo asset are one publication). Independent corroboration of the rebrand date and continued use comes from search-indexed third-party pages (banks.kg, brandfetch, news), a different observation path from the fetched assets.
uncertainties: No separately published square app-icon or emblem-only SVG file was found on the site (only /logo/favicon.png raster, unusable as source); the emblem-only variant relies on isolating the emblem path from the official lockup SVG during candidate preparation.
The official 2024 announcement page could not be checked in an archive snapshot; date taken from the live page text and corroborating search results.

variant.basis: Primary variant is the lockup (emblem + wordmark + ®). The standalone emblem exists as a single discrete subpath (.st1, #7FC344) inside the same original SVG; the standalone icon variant is obtainable by narrowing the viewBox to the emblem region without altering geometry or colors. The wordmark lockup itself is not icon-suitable per catalog policy.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem contours survive: outer leaf arc, the cut corner, the inner notch and the detached lower-left stroke are complete; edges crisp in 240px renders on both themes; single flat #7FC344 fill matches the source exactly; internal transparency preserved.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Aspect of the emblem region (374x355) is nearly square; uniform scale and centering leave ~1.35px clear margins top/bottom and full-width use; no stretching, cropping of emblem detail, or added margins. Whole-emblem fit in the square cell is complete and balanced.
candidate.rationale: Standalone green leaf/«K» emblem isolated from the bank's official post-2024-05-09 identity SVG (https://www.kompanion.kg/logo/kompanion-logo.svg, receipt-bound original Illustrator export). The lockup itself is unsuitable (accompanying wordmark), but the emblem is a single discrete path in the same original vector, so extracting it preserves original geometry and color without tracing or redrawing. It supersedes the pre-2024 pinwheel baseline.
candidate.role: Standalone brand emblem (transparent background, no field), the mark portion of the official БАНК КОМПАНЬОН lockup, used as the bank's symbol in the post-2024 identity.
transforms: Working SVG built from the original emblem path only: viewBox narrowed from '0 0 2270 643.75' to the emblem region (93 142.85 374 355.3) and uniform scale 0.144385 with centering translation into the 54x54 canvas; no geometry, color or masking changes.

SVGO (repository svgo.config.mjs, svgo 4.x via npx) on a copy: flattened the transform into path coordinates, lowercased fill; 424 -> 389 bytes (8.3% smaller). Working and optimized versions were rendered independently and compared visually before choosing the optimized bytes; faithful and converter-compatible, so optimized output selected as final.svg.
candidate.variant: Post-2024 standalone emblem variant, green #7FC344, no wordmark, no backing field. Matches the emblem in the official lockup and the mark shown at the head of the rebrand announcement page.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: The accepted baseline is the superseded pre-2024 four-petal pinwheel in blue/green (#007DC5/#D7DF23/#A6CE39). The candidate is the bank's post-2024 leaf/«K» emblem in solid green #7FC344 — a different, evidenced rebrand design for the same bank, not a serialization or presentation change.

proposals.reason: The baseline pinwheel icon is the pre-2024 Kompanion Bank logo. The bank officially introduced an updated identity on 2024-05-09 (20th anniversary): a green leaf/«K» emblem with the KOMPANION BANK wordmark. The live official site serves this identity as an original Adobe Illustrator-exported SVG at https://www.kompanion.kg/logo/kompanion-logo.svg (receipt evidence/15985/research-1f971565cfd34471b29afde2cab58bdd/fetch-504fcacd66644635a95ae4cb65b16495/receipt.json, body sha256 c5dd5588...84e9fea). The lockup is not icon-suitable (accompanying wordmark), but the standalone green #7FC344 emblem exists as a single discrete path (.st1) inside the same original vector, extractable without tracing or redrawing.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector (Illustrator-exported SVG) of the bank's current post-2024-05-09 brand mark, served by the official domain as its live header logo. Contains the standalone green #7FC344 leaf/«K» emblem as one path, extractable without tracing. Supersedes the baseline pinwheel, which predates the 2024 rebrand.

sources.observation: Official announcement «Трансформация Банка Компаньон» introduces the updated logo dated 9 May 2024: new green leaf mark. Fetched HTML (313585 bytes, sha256 f1e01f24de48c5b2f0fbfba105668e1ec2abc6a19d262961862ffd40a7056ee3) references /logo/kompanion-logo.svg as the site header logo; no old pinwheel artwork appears on the page.

sources.observation: Original vector retrieved via workflow fetch (7251 bytes, sha256 c5dd55886d708190486b811596dfc5f61c11c0666e9aa9de09be517aa84e9fea). Adobe Illustrator 27.5.0 export; viewBox 0 0 2270 643.75; .st0 fill #007DC5 (wordmark + ®), .st1 fill #7FC344 (standalone leaf/«K» emblem, one path). Genuine original vector, not a traced raster; referenced as the live site header logo.

Two web searches independently corroborated the May 2024 rebrand (banks.kg directory, brandfetch page, AmCham newsletter) and continued operation under the new identity (site news items Sep 2025 - Jan 2026). Operating bank/brand record, not historical.
